responsibility: Implements backward propagation of indirect loads through address PHIs. During a dominator walk it recognizes loads of pointers defined by PHI nodes, checks virtual-use dominance and trapping/volatility constraints, inserts corresponding PHIs or edge loads for the dereferenced values, reuses previously propagated dereference results when possible, and rewrites or removes the original MEM_REF loads so later PHI optimizations can turn address-selection patterns into value-selection patterns.
